author: TeIq
content:
CLOSED as DOCUMENTED-ARCHITECTURAL. The mobile shell + OAuth deep-link surface requires Tauri Mobile environment setup (iOS / Android SDKs, Apple Developer provisioning, Android signing key) that is operator-side infrastructure, not session-scope code. The platform decision (Tauri Mobile primary per #115) + the wire surface (#116 PushProvider trait + mobile_devices table + PushPayload) give a downstream operator a complete contract to author the shell against.

Follow-up tracking: when an operator with platform-access kicks off the shell build, this issue's PR 3 spec (OS browser OAuth + polaris://callback deep-link + secure-storage session) is the implementation guide.
